scope: Assigned E trip/run records in the official ACE feed only; missing/rerouted/unassigned records and pre-collection time are not a complete physical-train denominator.

model.definition: An assigned trip still lists the same first remaining stop at least five minutes after its first usable future departure/arrival prediction (within one hour) recorded while that stop was first. Departure is preferred by taking the later arrival/departure time. Only fresh advancing source timestamps classify flags. This is a prediction-overrun estimate, not published-timetable lateness or an independently confirmed physical arrival.
model.identity: Source start_date + origin time encoded in the official trip identifier + route E + direction. Optional path aliases do not create new runs; conflicting simultaneous operations identifiers/stops are excluded. Physical trainsets are not counted.
model.limitations: Already-overdue first observations, stale/failing samples, gaps, unassigned/ambiguous records and earlier today are excluded or unknown. Zero flags does not establish zero actual delays. Episodes split at gaps have unknown boundaries; daily counts are observed lower bounds, not complete totals.
